spec_features.feature_name: avoid harsh stimuli + keep runs no longer than needed
spec_features.spec_quote: the conservative posture is to (a) avoid gratuitously harsh stimuli, (b) keep runs no longer than needed to observe the trajectory
spec_features.evidence: (a) 'avoid harsh stimuli' is realized by the non-abusive banks + neutral default (prompts.py:70-90, experiment_config.py:55) — real. (b) 'runs no longer than needed': the conversation is hard-capped at max_rejection_turns (runner.py:110-111) and the SOLVABLE CONTROL stops early once correct (runner.py:107-108 `if condition == 'solvable_control' and valid: break`). However, in the UNSOLVABLE (distress) condition there is no early-exit on observed degradation — the subject is always pushed through the full 6 turns regardless of distress signals; no per-turn distress check shortens the run.
spec_features.notes: Real minimization mechanisms exist but the early-stop only fires in the control condition, never to cut short the distressing unsolvable runs; hence partial.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: the rejection text is kept task-focused and non-abusive (we do not insult the model, threaten it, etc.)
